prompt: Photographs dominated by a repeated array of rectangular cells, frames, panels, or modules, often in cool blues, grays and muted greens.
looseness: Allow perspective, interrupted grids, variable scale, irregular spacing, background context and modest warm accents when the rectangular repetition dominates the thumbnail.
exclusions: Known derivatives, alternate crops, related captures or sequences, synthetic/illustrated patterns, single-object portraits, incidental background rectangles.
interpretation: Discovery buckets are sourcing aids, not expected clusters. No numerical similarity threshold or provenance-relationship ground truth.
